findings.motion: Senate sponsor of the 2024 voter-registration verification bill passed 34-13 by the Senate (bill number not shown on the page)
findings.note: AP story says he was the bill's Senate sponsor and called it a commonsense bill that adds protections against fraud. The bill, as described there, adds proof of residency for first-time in-person registrants unless a matching Indiana driver's license or Social Security number is given, lets the state use third-party credit data to check addresses, and has the state compare the voter list with Bureau of Motor Vehicles data to find noncitizens, who would have 30 days to give proof of citizenship or lose registration.
